content: Type-safe navigation in Jetpack Compose uses kotlinx.serialization. Define routes as objects (no args) or data classes (with args) annotated with @Serializable. Build the graph using composable<RouteType> { backStackEntry -> }. Retrieve arguments within the composable using backStackEntry.toRoute<RouteType>(). In ViewModels, use savedStateHandle.toRoute<RouteType>() to access route arguments. Navigate to destinations using navController.navigate(RouteType(args...)). This requires androidx.navigation:navigation-compose version 2.8.0 or higher.
